body:
Restart-when: `.objectui-sha` on objectstack `main` names an objectui commit that contains `3a5817f07` (objectui#6356, PR objectui#10822)

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p3` · `domain:spec` · `area:records` · **`pm:on-hold`** (install surface)

Triage: lands in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:4400` (`ObjectTimelinePropsSchema.items`, 「the author owns the item shape」) ⇒ `domain:spec`. Rationale: objectui now declares the timeline element (a feed item or a gantt row, judged by `variant`), so the spec's sentence is no longer true, and an author reading `ComponentPropsMap['object-timeline']` gets no guidance. It is a cross-repo child with no runtime effect in this repo ⇒ **p3**.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01W89enF2dYV7K4N2Fbfj33f` · 2026-09-27T20:23Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card (no comments) and objectui#6356's landing as the card relays it.

History: the body's `Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#10822` is satisfied, because that PR merged on 2026-09-27 as `3a5817f07`. The card's own reader line names the real gate: objectstack's `.objectui-sha` must cover that commit. The pin is `f8a9d0fb05` (objectui, 2026-09-24), so it does not. That makes this a hold on the install surface, with the mechanical restart line above.

**At restart (the card's direction, sequencing only):** re-read the element union at the pin, then decide whether the spec declares it or keeps `z.unknown()` with a corrected description that points at objectui's declared element. ⛔ It does not fork a second vocabulary.
